queryglot ask-widget keyframes + playground — direction 2: command-palette anatomy, warm paper light / ink dark, single fixed indigo accent, Bricolage Grotesque + Instrument Sans + IBM Plex Mono.
Each artboard has a Dark toggle in its tweak chips (Idle/Answered/Playground default light; Thinking/Abstained default dark). The playground top bar shows the shipping control: a moon/sun pill toggle.
Constants: the exact validated query is always shown; abstention reads as calm information, never error.
